normalization_provenance: the tile is np.clip(tile, 0, max_clip_value) and then A.ToFloat(max_value=max_clip_value)
the divisor is the clip value, not 255; dividing by 255 compresses the input to 78.4% of the trained contrast range and this checkpoint responds with a flat map near 0.51
input_contract.checkpoint_head_note: config.json declares 1139 classes while the upstream code hardcodes 1039; the head is unused under forward_features and the runner resizes it to the checkpoint so the load stays strict

comparability: maps are produced at the training scale, not the source scale; a map from this lane may not be pooled pixelwise with a native-scale lane without resampling back
single depth centre per invocation: this lane has no built-in stability aggregation
